text:
maya_cs: Heads-up — NimbleHealth just added two new product teams (Search & Analytics) and asked for increased throughput for embeddings. Jason looped me in. They want a ramp in ~6 weeks and asked about Dedicated pricing and regional options.

jason_am: They pushed a staging change last week and volume spiked 3x. Asking for a Dedicated pool quote; legal also asked about EU data residency.

li-wei_eng: Quick Qs — what's their observed peak RPS, avg seq len, and model list? That'll determine if Dedicated + quantization is needed.

maya_cs: From logs: peak ~450 req/min for embeddings, avg seq len ~600 tokens for embed requests, gen sessions ~40 concurrent. Models: embed-encoder-v2 (quantized), conv-gen-1. They want p99 gen latency under 100ms.

samira_success: Sounds like a classic expansion signal — new teams + higher throughput. We should schedule enablement + an SRE dive. Also capture feedback: they mentioned wanting KV cache visibility and better per-token cost breakdown.

onboard-bot: Reminder — Enablement call with NimbleHealth scheduled for 2025-06-10 16:00 UTC. Meeting link: https://meet.example/abc :calendar: Please confirm attendees.

jason_am: Sales is prepping a pilot ask. Estimated cost delta vs hosted ~+35% for Dedicated. Will confirm exact numbers, but they want a formal pilot agreement.

li-wei_eng: Propose hybrid: Dedicated for conv-gen-1 (low latency), Hosted for embeddings with aggressive prefix/KV caching to reduce cost. Need to validate KMS/HSM compatibility for EU.

maya_cs: Action items: 1) Samira to send enablement invite + agenda. 2) Jason to confirm QPS, contract ask, and pilot scope. 3) Li-wei to prep perf delta, fallback plan, and infra checklist (KMS, regions). I'll add notes to the CS playbook and track as expansion opportunity.

samira_success: On it. I'll add 'KV cache visibility' and 'per-token cost breakdown' to the agenda and ask them for sample prompt sets and traffic patterns.

jason_am: FYI — NimbleHealth mentioned they may prefer an EU Private deployment in Q3 if latency/cost tradeoffs don't work out.

li-wei_eng: If they move to EU Private, we'll need infra sign-off and capacity planning. Pinging @oliver_infra.

oliver_infra: Got it — ping received. I'll validate available capacity and regional constraints and report EOD tomorrow.

maya_cs: :thumbsup: Perfect. After enablement I’ll run a short survey to capture quality/regression feedback and note any renewal risk/upsell timing.

maya_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a consolidated playbook entry and share the pilot checklist here.
